title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented University at Buffalo traditions, from the first-year human logo to annual cultural celebrations.

cards.title: Become part of the Interlocking UB
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend and New Student Orientation
cards.notes: Join the incoming class as it assembles the human interlocking UB logo during the fall Welcome Weekend tradition.
cards.short_summary: A first-year class forms UB’s human logo together.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says thousands of incoming first-year students form the iconic human interlocking UB at the start of each fall semester; the tradition was established in 2005.
cards.access_notes: Presented as part of Welcome Weekend; consult current orientation programming for participation details.

cards.title: Carry True Blue into Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Fall campus celebration
cards.notes: Plan around the fall reunion weekend, when students, alumni, families and friends gather for UB spirit programming.
cards.short_summary: UB’s annual fall reunion of campus and alumni communities.
cards.evidence_claim: UB identifies Homecoming & Family Weekend as an annual tradition and dates the earliest archived mention of a UB Homecoming football game to November 6, 1924.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in fall; check the current Homecoming & Family Weekend schedule for event access.

cards.title: Take the mud volleyball challenge
cards.subtitle: Spring tradition
cards.notes: Register or volunteer through the current Oozefest information when the spring mud-volleyball tournament is announced.
cards.short_summary: A long-running UB mud-volleyball gathering dating to 1984.
cards.evidence_claim: UB states that Oozefest began in 1984 with 16 teams and is a spring mud volleyball tournament involving students, alumni, staff and community members.
cards.access_notes: Held each spring; registration, volunteering and sponsorship information is provided by UB when available.

cards.title: See International Fiesta performances
cards.subtitle: Student Association cultural showcase
cards.notes: Watch student clubs present rehearsed music and dance performances representing the cultures they choose to showcase.
cards.short_summary: A Student Association event centered on student-club cultural performances.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says International Fiesta is hosted by the Student Association and features student clubs rehearsing music and dance performances that showcase their cultures.
cards.access_notes: Consult the Student Association or UB events calendar for the current event schedule and attendance details.

cards.title: Mark the semester with Fall Fest
cards.subtitle: Student Association seasonal festival
cards.notes: Look for the Student Association’s Fall Fest listing and attend the scheduled music programming with friends or classmates.
cards.short_summary: One half of UB’s Student Association seasonal festival pair.
cards.evidence_claim: UB lists Fall Fest as a Student Association-hosted seasonal festival and says it features popular-music artists.
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Association and UB events calendar for current dates, venue and entry requirements.

cards.title: Welcome spring at Springfest
cards.subtitle: Student Association seasonal festival
cards.notes: Follow current Student Association announcements to catch the spring festival’s scheduled music programming on campus.
cards.short_summary: A spring counterpart to UB’s Fall Fest tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: UB lists Springfest among its Student Association-hosted seasonal festivals and says these festivals feature popular-music artists.
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Association and UB events calendar for current dates, venue and entry requirements.

cards.title: Catch UB on the Green
cards.subtitle: Summer concert series
cards.notes: Check the current summer lineup, then make time for a concert staged around UB’s green spaces.
cards.short_summary: UB’s summer concert-series tradition in campus green spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UB identifies UB on the Green as its summer concert series and describes it as a way to enjoy campus green spaces.
cards.access_notes: Check UB’s current event listings for summer dates, location and attendance details.

cards.title: Explore the Latino Cultural Bazaar
cards.subtitle: UB cultural-bazaar tradition
cards.notes: Attend to encounter classmates’ food, customs and cultural presentations when the year’s bazaar is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: One of UB’s annually coordinated cultural-bazaar celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says it coordinates cultural bazaars throughout the year, including a Latino cultural bazaar, to showcase students’ foods, customs and traditions.
cards.access_notes: Check current cultural-bazaar announcements for the date, venue and participation details.

cards.title: Explore the LGBTQ+ Cultural Bazaar
cards.subtitle: UB cultural-bazaar tradition
cards.notes: Attend to learn from classmates’ food, customs and cultural presentations when the year’s bazaar is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A UB cultural-bazaar celebration for LGBTQ+ students and the community.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says it coordinates cultural bazaars throughout the year, including an LGBTQ+ cultural bazaar, to showcase students’ foods, customs and traditions.
cards.access_notes: Check current cultural-bazaar announcements for the date, venue and participation details.

cards.title: Explore the Native American Cultural Bazaar
cards.subtitle: UB cultural-bazaar tradition
cards.notes: Attend to encounter classmates’ food, customs and cultural presentations when the year’s bazaar is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A UB cultural-bazaar celebration highlighting Native American communities.
cards.evidence_claim: UB says it coordinates cultural bazaars throughout the year, including a Native American cultural bazaar, to showcase students’ foods, customs and traditions.
cards.access_notes: Check current cultural-bazaar announcements for the date, venue and participation details.
